ev.q: CDC was notified of 119 B. stabilis patient infections among 10 states meeting the case definition
Among 87 patients with available clinical data, 59 (68%) had signs and symptoms of infection
Among 102 patients with vital status information, 14 (14%) deaths were reported
Among 117 patients with available information, 104 (89%) are known to have undergone ultrasonography during their admission
In July 2021, the Virginia Department of Health notified CDC of a cluster of eight invasive infections

methods_quotes.q: match within 12 single nucleotide variants, >99% coverage across the entire B. stabilis reference genome
